Sweep и Foraging Fortune — что это: Sweep and Foraging Fortune: what they are
Sweep — сколько брёвен ломается одним уд: Sweep is how many logs break with one hit. It's the main speed stat: a Galatea tree falls in fewer hits, and every fully felled tree drops a Tree Gift.
Foraging Fortune — шанс получить лишние: Foraging Fortune is the chance of extra logs: 100 Fortune = twice the logs on average. There's also Fortune for a specific tree (Fig Fortune, Mangrove Fortune, Helix Fortune) from Moonglade talismans and collector attributes.
Бросок топора (ПКМ) рубит дерево издалек: An axe throw (right-click) chops a tree from afar, but with a Sweep penalty. The Axe Toss perk removes the penalty for 10 s, Homing Axe makes the throw homing, Ricochet bounces it to a nearby tree.
